claims.statement: Default text task uses built-in color/shape short documents and next-token continuation.
claims.scope: Exactly the documented default text CPU entry with no --data; 12 authored rule-based documents, not a downloaded corpus or evidence of language ability.

evidence.supports: No --data selects toy_documents, shifted inputs/targets and masked language loss.
Four colors by three shapes generate short text; one next-token shift.
12 actual color/shape samples; toy_documents called once; the default text entry completes.

verification.expected: 12 color/shape documents and one CPU forward/backward
verification.observed: 12 documents; default text called toy_documents once; loss5.752984046936035; no update
verification.details: Default argv retained, actual TinyLM and masked_loss run; generated documents checked independently.

claims.statement: Default sft uses assistant demonstrations of addition of two small integers.
claims.scope: Exactly the no--data sft CPU entry; operands0..3 and answer-only supervised tokens, not general instruction or arithmetic capability.

evidence.supports: 16 user-addition/assistant-answer conversations; only assistant content/EOS supervised.
The sft branch supplies those conversations to rendered chat and masked loss.
Every a+b target recomputed; toy_conversations called once; real default SFT completes.

verification.expected: 16 correct tiny addition demonstrations; assistant-only targets
verification.observed: 16 conversations independently recomputed; default sft finite loss5.465846538543701 and8 effective positions
verification.details: Addition targets recomputed from prompt operands; current render_chat supervision inspected and own-data labels decoded.

claims.statement: Default vision asks about a programmatically generated circle or square.
claims.scope: Exactly no--data vision CPU entry; colored16x16 rule-based pictures and shape? answer; no natural-image QA ability is measured.

evidence.supports: Random color and circle/square; vision question shape?; shape target, scene image supplied.
RGB image is drawn by geometric mask and passed through vision encoder/projector.
Both shape masks checked,49 and81 colored pixels; default vision calls scene four times and completes.

verification.expected: Synthetic circle/square image route; finite forward/backward
verification.observed: scene returned3x16x16 with49 circle pixels or81 square pixels; default vision finite loss5.961961269378662
verification.details: Read actual image-generation masks and execute both; main performs its four-example batch. T.2 itself has no figure requiring render.

claims.statement: Adding --data and a supported JSONL path switches the three task entries to the reader supplied records.
claims.scope: Supported formats only: text record.text; sft messages or question/answer; vision image/question/answer with image paths relative to JSONL directory. This does not promise arbitrary file formats or replace schema validation.

evidence.supports: --data is loaded into task-specific examples/records, with toy branch bypassed for nonempty records.
UTF-8 JSONL records loaded line by line.
Vision uses actual referenced RGB image, question, and answer with relative image path.
Text/messages/QA/vision own-data dry runs succeed with all toy counters0; text input and scored assistant target decoded; empty JSONL rejects.

verification.expected: Custom text, SFT messages/QA and vision records consumed; no toy fallback
verification.observed: Four own-data dry runs succeed; toy source calls all0; text decoded CUSTOM QZ9.; scored assistant text XYZ; both empty files reject
verification.details: Fixtures preserved permanently; real computations and no-update checks apply to each; two empty-file errors separately recorded.

claims.statement: The three default commands do forward/backward without parameter updates or checkpoint saves; --train enables optimizer updates and persistence.
claims.scope: Default task text/sft/vision; train inverse checked only with one batch of tiny width8 CPU models. No full training or capability claim.

evidence.supports: Dry run exactly1 iteration; backward and gradient clip always; optimizer.step and all weight/report saves gated by args.train.
Actual saver writes weights and optimizer/RNG state, then atomic temporary-file replacement.
Dry-run step/save counts0 and all parameter bytes identical; train step counts1, changed tensors17/17/26, checkpoints/JSON saved.

verification.expected: Dry-run parameter equality and no saves; one-step --train changes weights and writes output
verification.observed: Three defaults changed0 tensors, no files; three one-step trains changed17,17,26 tensors and saved checkpoints/reports
verification.details: Counters wrap real optimizer/saver without replacing them. Stored before/after parameter SHA values and actual generated outputs retain exact evidence.

claims.statement: Forward prediction uses current weights; backward calculates loss derivatives; parameter adjustment is performed by the optimizer.
claims.scope: Standard differentiable computation and this entry; reverse derivative signals are distinct from parameter mutation. Clipping may modify .grad values in place during the dry run, not weights.

evidence.supports: Prediction logits are computed from present embeddings/blocks/output weights and loss from masked targets.
backward differentiates using chain rule and accumulates gradients in leaves.
step is explicitly the parameter-update operation.
Actual optimizer implementation performs the in-place parameter update.
Current-runtime backward leaves scalar values3 and2 unchanged; CLI dry-run equality and one-step updates independently verified.

claims.statement: Report mode/task/device match the documented CPU entry; loss and grad_norm are finite and grad_norm is positive in each default.
claims.scope: mode/task/device are top-level report fields; loss/grad_norm are printed in per-step entries and in history[0]. Values here verify selected seeded default smoke runs, not all user datasets or learning quality.

evidence.supports: grad_norm comes from clip_grad_norm_; entry includes loss and grad_norm; report contains mode/task/device/history.
All three default reports dry-run-no-weight-update andcpu; text/sft/vision tasks correct; loss and norms finite/positive.

verification.expected: Correct mode/task/device and finite loss plus positive finite norm
verification.details: math.isfinite checks both quantities, norm>0 checked; stdout saved unchanged. Norm is preclipping global norm; maximum clipping threshold1.0 is not the reported norm ceiling.

claims.statement: Text/SFT count scored positions; vision omits that count and prints null, which does not mean zero supervision.
claims.scope: effective_tokens counts nonignored batch labels for text/SFT. Current vision main branch does not expose its denominator; actual masked_loss still requires nonzero scored labels.

evidence.supports: Modal branch assigns effective=None; text/sft assigns count of y!=-100; entry JSON serializes None asnull.
Assistant target construction and ignored/padded position mask define what counts.
Zero scored labels raise; nonzero labels normalize valid cross-entropy.
Default counts111 and8; vision null despite finite loss/backward and positive global norm.

verification.expected: text/sft positive effective labels; vision null while having active targets
verification.observed: Default text111, SFT8, visionnull; default vision loss finite and grad_norm1.8985438346862793
verification.details: Direct field check plus actual loss guard demonstrates null means unreported denominator; no invented vision effective-token count.

claims.statement: A finite positive global grad_norm proves at least one nonzero gradient, without proving every parameter received a gradient or that model capability passed an exam.
claims.scope: Finite global norm of current batch only. Some task-specific modules can be unused; this entry performs no heldout evaluation or answer-generation capability metric.

evidence.supports: Norm combines all existing gradients as a single vector; absent gradients are omitted. Positive finite vector norm entails at least one nonzero component.
Default entry evaluates batch loss/backward/norm only, no validation/generation/accuracy routine.
Two scalar parameters give gradients6 and0 with global norm6; actual vision has8 zero/absent-gradient tensors while global norm remains positive.

factual_accuracy.details: 逐主張對照目前原稿、actual default/custom-data/train CPU code branches及原始官方 API；九項實質主張已核實。未閱讀舊技術/reader報告或作者修正摘要。

numeric_verification.details: 原文只要求有限loss及正有限global norm，而未主張固定loss數值。實際三default均通過；text/SFT有效位置111/8，visionnull。兩參數算例L=x²+0y於x3,y2 gives gradients6/0 and norm6；例數12/16、shape mask49/81 independently checked。

source_verification.details: 當前repo source與永久exact snapshots SHA一致；PyTorch官方v2.8.0 tag原始碼已取得並直接讀其backward/global norm/step契約。HTTP403 docs失敗及fallback記錄已保留。安裝CPU torch2.14.1+cpu版本與官方tag差異明示，當前語義用實際CPU執行另行核對。
